title: FX Brief — 30 Sep 2026
intro:
Broad-based USD strength dominates Asian session as risk-off sentiment weighs on commodity currencies and JPY weakness persists despite month-end flows.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
1. USD +0.17% — Safe-haven demand and broad strength across all pairs driving dollar gains
2. CHF +0.12% — Defensive flows support franc; outperforming vs euro and commodity bloc
3. EUR -0.08% — Modest weakness vs dollar but holding firm against GBP and risk-sensitive currencies
4. GBP -0.11% — Underperforming euro; slipping across the board in cautious trade
5. NZD -0.24% — Risk aversion and commodity weakness hammer kiwi alongside aussie
6. JPY -0.52% — Continued weakness despite month-end repatriation expectations; crosses under pressure
7. AUD -0.56% — Worst G10 performer; risk-off and commodity concerns drive broad selloff
8. CAD -0.35% — Oil sensitivity and USD strength weigh; modest gains vs commodity peers only
